full_name: James A. Steintrager | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: James A. Steintrager is an assistant professor of comparative literature at the University of California at Irvine, where he specializes in eighteenth-century French, German, and English drama, aesthetics, and libertine fiction.
